title: Reserve credit for reinsurance.
bodyText: Any health maintenance organization that takes credit for reserves on risks ceded to a reinsurer shall be subject to provisions of chapter 431 related to credit for reinsurance.
bodyHtml: [§432D-9.5]  Reserve credit for reinsurance.  Any health maintenance organization that takes credit for reserves on risks ceded to a reinsurer shall be subject to provisions of chapter 431 related to credit for reinsurance. [L 2000, c 74, §2]
